1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __a machine-readable tag affixed to an external surface of the test tube__.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath, oriented for reading downwards, __specifically embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __configured for long-term sample storage at cryogenic temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the embedded MTP is sealed within the polymer material__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and __at least two of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less, __wherein the automated robot and automated sampling device are configured to operate at said low temperature__.

15. (Original) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a MTP in plastic or comprising heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP.

16. (Original) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; and reading the MTP.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20 C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the embedded MTP is sealed within the polymer material__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath, oriented for reading downwards, __specifically embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube__.
